sut.name: rustfs-gateway-fs
sut.assembly: rustfs-gateway-fs behind rustfs-gateway-server, SigV4 verified, plaintext plus a TLS listener (throwaway self-signed authority) for TLS-only scenarios
sut.provisional_reason: measured against the matrix's own launcher; the general-purpose server binary is tracked in rustfs/gateway#624 and these rows are re-measured when it lands

scenarios.detail: aws-cli is not a backup tool; it has no repository format to restore
aws s3 presign signs GetObject URLs only
